entries.title: Overthinking Reset: Name the Loop
entries.hook: Before the loop runs your evening, which sentence names it?

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: I am reviewing the same conversation for the fourth time. That sentence is the name.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Once named, the loop loses its claim to be new information.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Choose the line that names the loop, then move to the facts.

entries.answer: I am reviewing the same conversation again.
entries.visualBrief: Calm study room at night with an adult woman pausing thoughtfully beside a notebook and a warm desk lamp, upper body only, hands below frame, deep teal and gold palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Say No Without a Long Explanation
entries.hook: A long refusal sounds like an invitation to negotiate.

turns.speaker: friend_a
turns.text: Can you drive us on Saturday?

turns.speaker: friend_b
turns.text: No, I cannot, but I hope you find a good ride.

turns.speaker: friend_a
turns.text: That was clear and kind. The explanation would only have blurred it.

entries.answer: A clear no and a warm close.
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime doorstep scene with two adult friends talking casually in daylight, chest-up framing, hands below frame, yellow and soft blue palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Overthinking Reset: Test the Facts
entries.hook: The loop asks the same question. Facts are asked once.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Loop question: did I sound foolish? Fact question: what did they actually say?

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Their words: that was clearer than last time. The facts are the review.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Name the loop, test the facts, choose the next action. That is the whole reset.

entries.answer: One fact question about what was actually said.
entries.visualBrief: Minimal bright room with an adult man writing three short lines in a notebook beside a window, upper body only, hands mostly visible and anatomically natural, warm cream and slate palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Refusals: Hear the Close
entries.hook: When is a request truly finished?

turns.speaker: friend_a
turns.text: Ask me again on Friday. It might be easier then.

turns.speaker: friend_b
turns.text: Friday does not change my answer. No, and I hope the event goes well.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The final answer is the close. Date changes do not reopen a refusal.

entries.answer: When the no stays the same answer.
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime park bench scene with two adult friends in friendly daylight conversation, relaxed posture, chest-up framing, hands below frame, green coral and cream palette, no readable text.
